profilePage.pageDescription: Manage the number and delivery channel used for irrigation, weather, and crop reminders.
profilePage.photoLimit: PNG, JPEG, or WebP · up to 5 MB
profilePage.cropRotateSub: Adjust the square crop before saving it to your profile.
profilePage.editIdentitySub: These details personalize field guidance and reminders.
profilePage.resetScrollHelp: Clears remembered scroll locations for dashboard sections on this device.
profilePage.alertsSub: Choose where irrigation and weather alerts should arrive.
profilePage.phoneHelp: Required for SMS and WhatsApp alerts.
profilePage.twilioNote: Your number is used only for farm alerts. Provider credentials must be configured by the project owner before SMS or WhatsApp delivery is active.
profilePage.historySub: Recent delivery attempts are kept private to your farmer account.
profilePage.recentSignInsSub: Only successful sign-ins to your farmer account are shown here.
profilePage.languageNoteBold: Language affects the entire application and voice advice.
profilePage.languageNoteSub: Switch between English, Kannada, Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil at any time.

thresholds.title: Moisture thresholds
thresholds.help: Set the minimum soil moisture that should trigger an irrigation recommendation for each crop stage.
thresholds.tip: Recommendations use this value together with live rain probability.
